_comment: Illustrated (painted) character art, milestone 5B prototype. Each creator entry points at a manifest generated by art_pipeline/extract_sheets.py and says which game looks the paintings depict. Illustrations are only used when they honestly match her current look ('base_look', allowed makeup, an outfit with art, no tattoos/visible piercings, measurements matching 'body'); otherwise the procedural renderer is used, so procedures and styling always stay visible. Art mode (settings): auto = use matching art, always = show the art even when it doesn't match (for reviewing), off = procedural only. 'outfits' maps game outfit ids to painted outfits; 'full_body' is the hero image per painted outfit; 'sprites' maps house animations to painted poses per painted outfit ('*' = any). Animations without a painted pose (sleep, recline) use the procedural renderer. 'expressions' are the painted busts per mood expression (see CreatorMood).

ava._house_scale_comment: Painted sprites are drawn this much larger in the house (the procedural sprites also get a larger head there) so faces stay readable at ~120 px.
